DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で予約しましたが、一人だけ先に来ました。連れが夜に着くので、受付方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人予約で本人先着同行者夜着の受付方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I booked for two people, but I have arrived on my own first. My companion will arrive tonight, so I would like to discuss how to check in.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you booked for two, arrived first yourself, and want to discuss check-in for your companion arriving tonight.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 人数は二人のままで、到着時間が別なのですね。お連れの方も車ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the booking is still for two people, but you are arriving at different times. Is your companion also coming by car?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、別の車です。私の受付が済めば、その車もそのまま入れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別車で来る同行者も本人受付後そのまま入れると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, in a separate car. I thought that once I had checked in, that car could just come straight in too.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought your companion in a separate car could enter directly after you checked in.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車の受付と入場案内も確認します。車が二台になることを予約情報に追記しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will also check the vehicle registration and entry instructions. Let us add to the booking that there will be two cars.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二台になると伝えます。遅い時間に受付が閉まる場合は、どう連絡すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二台利用を申告し受付終了時の連絡方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will let you know that we are using two cars. If reception is closed by the time they arrive late, how should they contact you?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Declare in Japanese that you will use two cars and ask how to make contact after reception closes.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 到着予定時刻を伺って、担当から連絡方法をご案内します。無断でゲートを通らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will ask for the expected arrival time, and the person responsible will explain how to contact us. Please do not go through the gate without permission.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午後八時ごろの予定です。連れには到着前に案内された連絡先へ電話するよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者の午後八時予定を伝え到着前電話を依頼すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: They expect to arrive around eight in the evening. I will tell my companion to phone the contact number provided before arriving.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State in Japanese that your companion expects to arrive at eight in the evening and that you will ask them to phone before arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その時刻で受け入れ可能か、いま確認します。連絡前に入場できるとは約束しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check now whether we can receive them at that time. Please do not promise them that they can enter before making contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け入れの返答を聞いてから連れへ伝えます。予約人数は二人で、車は二台です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 遅着受入れ回答後に連れへ案内し二人二台を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell my companion after I hear whether their arrival can be accommodated. The booking is for two people with two cars.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will pass on the instructions after receiving the answer about late arrival, and confirm two people and two cars.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。遅着の担当へ確認します。お知らせありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check with the person handling late arrivals. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この米を親と半分ずつ使いたいです。買った袋を二つに分けて持ち帰れるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入米を親と分け二袋で持ち帰れるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to share this rice equally with my parent. Could I discuss having the bag I buy divided into two bags to take home?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the rice you buy can be divided with your parent and taken home in two bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋分けの取扱いを確認します。二袋とも同じ方が持ち帰りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check our policy on splitting bags. Will the same person take both bags home?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、一袋は親が別の家へ持って行きます。商品名や注意書きも両方で読めるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別世帯へ持帰る親にも商品名注意書きが必要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, my parent will take one bag to a different home. I would like the product name and instructions to be readable on both bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your parent, who is taking a bag to a separate household, also needs the product name and instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分けると元の表示が片方にしか残らないことがあります。表示の写しを用意できるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: If we divide it, the original label may remain on only one bag. I will check whether we can provide a copy of the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 商品名だけでなく保存上の注意も必要です。自分の袋だけ元の表示を残すのでは困ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品名だけでなく保存注意を両袋へ残したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: We need the storage precautions as well as the product name. It would be a problem if only my bag kept the original label.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for both bags to retain the storage precautions as well as the product name.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者が包装と表示の方法を確認します。お持ちの袋は食品を入れるための物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check how to package and label it. Are the bags you have intended for food?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一枚は買い物袋なので、米を直接入れません。食品用の袋を用意できるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 買物袋へ米を直接入れず食品用袋の用意可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: One is a shopping bag, so I will not put rice directly into it. I would also like to ask whether you can provide food-safe bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not put rice directly in the shopping bag, and ask whether food-safe bags can be provided.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 用意できる袋と料金をご説明します。説明後に分け方を決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain which bags we can provide and their cost. Please decide how to divide it after hearing the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 食品用の二袋と、両方に付ける表示をお願いします。親へも保存上の注意を渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食品用二袋と両袋表示を依頼し親へ保存注意を渡すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please provide two food-safe bags with labels on both. I will also give my parent the storage precautions.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request in Japanese two food-safe bags and labels for both, and say that you will give your parent the storage precautions.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その方法で準備します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will prepare it that way. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。何か報告がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. Is there anything to report?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 清掃する部屋に空き瓶とメモがあります。ごみとして片づけてよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 客室空瓶とメモがあり廃棄可否を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are empty bottles and a note in the room I am cleaning. I would like to check whether I can clear them away as rubbish.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that there are empty bottles and a note in the guest room, and ask whether they may be discarded.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メモには何と書いてありますか。瓶はまだその部屋にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What does the note say? Are the bottles still in that room?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 返却するので残してほしいと書いてあります。瓶は机にあり、袋には入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返却希望メモと瓶未袋詰めで机上保持を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says to leave them because they will be returned. The bottles are on the desk; I have not put them in a bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that the note asks for the bottles to be kept for return, and that they remain on the desk without being bagged.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら空でも廃棄しないでください。お客様の意向と部屋の状態を責任者へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, do not discard them even though they are empty. I will tell the supervisor what the guest wants and the state of the room.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。使用済みだからごみと決めず、メモと一緒にそのまま残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 空瓶を廃棄物と決めずメモと現状保持すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not assume they are rubbish just because they have been used. I will leave them as they are with the note.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not classify the empty bottles as rubbish and will leave them and the note as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。清掃してよい範囲も確認します。机のほかの物は動かしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. I will also check which areas you may clean. Have you moved anything else on the desk?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ動かしていません。瓶の周りの拭き掃除は、確認が済んでから行いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他物品未移動で瓶周辺清掃を確認後行いたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not moved anything yet. I would like to wipe around the bottles after the check is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not moved other items and would like to clean around the bottles after confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その範囲を確認して案内します。清掃完了の報告には、確認待ちの箇所を残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check that area and let you know. In your cleaning completion report, include the areas still awaiting confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 机の瓶は返却予定で未移動、周辺の清掃は確認待ちとして報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 瓶返却予定未移動と周辺清掃確認待ちを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will report that the bottles on the desk are to be returned and have not been moved, and that cleaning around them is awaiting confirmation.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that the bottles are to be returned and have not been moved, and that cleaning the surrounding area awaits confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。責任者へ伝えますので、ほかの指示済みの作業へ進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I will tell the supervisor, so please move on to the other work you have already been instructed to do.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。今日は何を相談されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前髪だけで予約しましたが、後ろの長さも整えたくなりました。今日追加できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前髪予約へ後ろ髪カットの当日追加を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I booked a fringe trim only, but now I would also like the length at the back tidied up. Can that be added today?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about adding a cut at the back today to your fringe-trim booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約内容と時間を確認します。後ろはどのくらい切りたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check your booking and the time available. How much would you like cut off the back?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三センチほどです。前髪カットの料金で全体も少し切れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 後ろ三センチ希望と前髪料金で全体少量も可能と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: About three centimetres. I thought the fringe-trim price would also cover cutting a little off the rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want three centimetres off the back and thought a small all-over trim was included in the fringe-trim price.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 全体のカットは別の施術になります。今の予約枠で対応できるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: An all-over haircut is a separate service. I will check whether we can do it within your current appointment slot.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 追加料金と終わる時刻を聞いてから決めたいです。まだ切り始めないでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加料金終了時刻確認前に施術を始めないよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to decide after hearing the extra charge and the finishing time. Could you please wait before starting to cut?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the service not to begin before you confirm the additional charge and finishing time.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: もちろんです。確認したところ、今日は全体のカットを入れる時間がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. I have checked, and there is not enough time today to fit in an all-over haircut.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では後ろは切らず、予約どおり前髪だけお願いします。全体は別日に予約したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日枠不足を受け前髪のみ実施と全体別日予約を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then please leave the back and just trim my fringe as booked. I would like to book an all-over cut for another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Respond in Japanese to the lack of time today by requesting only the fringe trim and an all-over haircut appointment on another day.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別日の空きをお調べします。前髪は眉が見えるくらいでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will look for an opening on another day. Would you like your fringe short enough to show your eyebrows?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、眉が見える長さです。今日は前髪だけで、全体の予約は施術後に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 眉が見える前髪のみ本日施術し全体予約は後で相談すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, a length that shows my eyebrows. Today I will have only my fringe trimmed, and we can discuss booking an all-over cut after the service.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that today's service is only a fringe trim showing your eyebrows, and that you will discuss the all-over haircut booking afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その範囲で始めます。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will begin with that scope. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 防災の勉強で、火災を知らせる練習をしたいです。今火事が起きているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現実の火災ではなく防災学習の通報練習と明示して相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: As part of disaster preparedness study, I would like to practise reporting a fire. There is no actual fire happening now.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain clearly in Japanese that this is fire-reporting practice for disaster preparedness, rather than a real fire.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 練習のご相談ですね。どこを伝える練習でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You are asking about practice, then. What location would you like to practise describing?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自宅の住所です。部屋の窓から煙が見えるという例を考えましたが、これは練習の題材です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自宅住所を使う煙の例が練習題材と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My home address. I thought of an example where smoke is visible from a room's window, but this is material for the practice.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the example involving smoke and your home address is a practice scenario.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。住所を先に、建物名や部屋番号も分かる範囲で伝える練習をしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Let us practise giving the address first, followed by the building name and room number as far as you know them.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番地は読めますが、建物名の漢字が読めません。書いたメモを用意してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 建物名漢字を読めないため事前メモ準備を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can read the street number, but I cannot read the kanji in the building name. May I prepare a written note?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about preparing a note in advance because you cannot read the building name's kanji.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 事前の準備に役立ちます。建物名が読めない時に伝えられる目印も整理しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: That will be helpful preparation. Let us also identify landmarks you can describe if you cannot read the building name.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口に青い看板があります。目印だけで住所の代わりにせず、番地と一緒に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 青い入口看板を住所の代替ではなく番地と併記すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a blue sign at the entrance. I will describe that along with the street number, rather than use the landmark instead of the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will give the blue entrance sign together with the street number, rather than as a replacement for the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今日は職員との練習にとどめ、緊急番号への実際の通報はしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Today, please keep this to practice with staff and do not make an actual call to the emergency number.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この窓口で練習します。住所、建物のメモ、青い看板を順に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 窓口練習で住所建物メモ目印を順に伝えると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will practise here at this counter. I will give the address, the note about the building, and the blue sign in that order.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will practise at the counter and give the address, building note, and landmark in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。練習を始めましょう。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us start practising. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日は何を相談されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方に体がだるくなりました。家族が原因を書いたメモもありますが、そのまま渡してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人倦怠感と家族原因メモを一緒に提示してよいか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I started feeling fatigued yesterday evening. I also have a note in which my family wrote down the cause. Is it all right to hand it over as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can present your own fatigue symptoms together with your family's note about the cause.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メモを見せてください。ご自身が感じたことと、家族の考えを分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the note. I will ask separately about what you felt yourself and what your family thinks.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私が分かるのは、夕食の前からだるかったことです。食事が原因という部分は家族の推測です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夕食前の本人症状と食事原因という家族推測を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: What I know is that I felt fatigued before dinner. The part saying that the meal caused it is my family's guess.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain separately in Japanese your symptoms before dinner and your family's guess that the meal was the cause.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 食事の前からなのですね。いつ何を感じたか、ご本人の言葉で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: So it started before the meal. Please tell me in your own words what you felt and when.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午後五時ごろからだるく、六時半に食事をしました。まだ原因は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 五時症状六時半食事の時系列と原因未確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I felt fatigued from around five in the afternoon and ate at six thirty. I still do not know the cause.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give in Japanese the timeline of symptoms at five and the meal at six thirty, and state that the cause is unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その順番を記録します。ご家族の推測を診断済みとして扱わなくてよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record that sequence. You do not need to treat your family's guess as an established diagnosis.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メモの原因という見出しを、自分で確認できた症状と分けて説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メモ原因見出しを本人確認症状と別に説明したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to explain the section headed 'Cause' in the note separately from the symptoms I can confirm myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to explain the note's 'Cause' heading separately from symptoms you have personally confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。分からない項目は分からないとおっしゃってください。続けて診察します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please say you do not know for any items you are unsure about. We will continue with the examination.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: だるさは食事前からで、原因は未確認です。家族の考えは別の参考情報としてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食前症状と未確認原因を再提示し家族推測を参考情報として渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The fatigue started before the meal, and the cause has not been confirmed. I will provide my family's thoughts separately as background information.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Restate in Japanese the symptoms before eating and unconfirmed cause, and provide your family's guess as reference information.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。その内容を踏まえて診察を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I will proceed with the examination taking that information into account.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この口座へ入金したいだけです。この積立の用紙も書く必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口座入金のみ希望で積立用紙記入が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only want to deposit money into this account. Do I also need to fill out this savings-plan form?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you only want to deposit money into the account, and ask whether the savings-plan form is necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 積立商品の申込みと、口座への入金は別です。その用紙はまだ書いていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Applying for a savings product and depositing money into an account are separate matters. Have you not filled out that form yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前も署名も書いていません。入金の順番で必要な紙だと思って受け取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 積立用紙未記名未署名で入金必須書類と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not written my name or signed it. I accepted it because I thought it was a form required as part of making a deposit.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the savings-plan form has neither your name nor signature, and you thought it was required for a deposit.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご希望を確認します。積立商品の申込みは希望されていないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me confirm what you want. You do not wish to apply for the savings product, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、今日は口座へ入金だけお願いします。定期的に引き落とす設定も希望しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本日入金のみで定期引落し設定も希望しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Correct. Today, please just deposit money into the account. I do not want to set up regular debits either.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that today you want only a deposit and do not want regular debits set up.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。入金額と対象口座を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Let us confirm the deposit amount and the account it is going into.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この通帳の口座へ三万円です。商品の申込書は返して、入金の控えだけ受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通帳口座三万円入金と商品申込書返却控え受領を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thirty thousand yen into the account in this bankbook. I would like to return the product application form and receive only the deposit receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request in Japanese a thirty-thousand-yen deposit into the bankbook's account, return of the product application form, and receipt of the deposit slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。処理する前に口座と金額をもう一度ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please check the account and amount once more before I process it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この口座へ三万円で合っています。積立の申込みはせず、入金をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 口座金額を確認し積立申込みなしの入金を指示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thirty thousand yen into this account is correct. Please make the deposit without applying for the savings plan.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the account and amount, and instruct that the deposit be made without a savings-plan application.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。入金を受け付けます。ご説明ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-YUZAWA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will accept the deposit. Thank you for explaining.

DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。仕分け作業で確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. Is there anything you would like to check about the sorting work?

DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この箱だけ荷札が濡れて、行き先を読めません。隣の箱と一緒にしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 荷札が濡れて行き先を読めない箱を、隣の箱と一緒にしてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-02.translation: The shipping label on just this box is wet, and I cannot read the destination. May I put it together with the box next to it?
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may group the box whose wet label makes its destination unreadable with the adjacent box.

DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ魚でも行き先が違うことがあります。その箱はまだ載せないでください。箱番号は読めますか。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even the same fish can have different destinations. Please do not load that box yet. Can you read the box number?

DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 箱番号は二一八です。読めないのは行き先の欄で、荷札は付いたままです。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱番号は二一八と読めるが、行き先の欄は読めず荷札は付いたままだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-04.translation: The box number is two-one-eight. It is the destination field that I cannot read, and the label is still attached.
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you can read box number two-one-eight, but not the destination field, and that the label remains attached.

DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二一八ですね。出荷表を確認します。今どこに置いてありますか。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-05.translation: Two-one-eight, then. I will check the shipping list. Where is it now?

DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 台車の横です。出荷済みの箱と混ざりそうなので、確認待ちの置き場へ移してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 台車の横では出荷済みの箱と混ざりそうなので、確認待ちの置き場へ移したいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-06.translation: Beside the trolley. It could get mixed up with boxes already cleared for shipping, so may I move it to the area for items awaiting confirmation?
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to move the box from beside the trolley to the waiting-for-confirmation area because it could get mixed up with boxes already cleared for shipping.

DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、青い線の内側へ置いてください。荷札は外さず、確認待ちの札を添えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, put it inside the blue line. Leave the shipping label attached and add a tag saying it is awaiting confirmation.

DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青い線の内側へ移して、荷札を残したまま確認待ちの札を付けます。別の箱の荷札は写しません。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 青い線の内側へ移し、元の荷札と確認待ちの札を残し、別箱の荷札を写さないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will move it inside the blue line and attach a waiting-for-confirmation tag while leaving its shipping label in place. I will not copy another box's label.
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will move it inside the blue line, retain the original label and add a waiting-for-confirmation tag, and not copy another box's label.

DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出荷表では二一八は別の取引先でした。新しい荷札はこちらで用意します。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-09.translation: According to the shipping list, two-one-eight is for a different customer. We will prepare a new shipping label here.

DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 隣の箱とは行き先が違うんですね。新しい荷札と箱番号を照合してから、指定の台車に載せます。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 隣の箱と行き先が違うと理解し、新しい荷札と箱番号を照合して指定の台車に載せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-10.translation: So its destination is different from the adjacent box. I will match the new label against the box number before loading it onto the designated trolley.
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you understand its destination differs from the adjacent box and will check the new label against the box number before loading it onto the designated trolley.

DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順序でお願いします。確認してくれてありがとうございます。指定の台車で次の作業をお願いします。
DLG-SC-AOM-HACHINOHE-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow that order. Thank you for checking. Please use the designated trolley for the next task.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お会計で何をご確認になりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: What would you like to check about your bill?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 焼きおにぎりが二つ入っていますが、まだ届いていません。会計の前に確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 焼きおにぎり二つが明細にあるが未提供なので、会計前に確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: There are two grilled rice balls on the bill, but they have not arrived yet. Could you check before I pay?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that two grilled rice balls appear on the itemised bill but have not been served, and ask for a check before payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 失礼しました。ほかの料理はすべてお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I am sorry about that. Have you finished all the other dishes?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 汁物と串焼きは食べました。届いていないのは焼きおにぎり二つだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 汁物と串焼きは食べており、未提供なのは焼きおにぎり二つだけだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: We ate the soup and grilled skewers. The only things that have not arrived are the two grilled rice balls.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have eaten the soup and grilled skewers and that only the two grilled rice balls have not been served.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 注文は入っていますが、焼き始めていませんでした。これからお作りするか、取り消すか、どちらにしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: The order was placed, but we had not started grilling them. Would you like us to make them now, or cancel them?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: もう出発するので、二つとも取り消してください。急いで焼いていただかなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 出発するため焼きおにぎり二つを取り消し、急いで作る必要はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: We are leaving now, so please cancel both. There is no need to rush to grill them for us.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are leaving, so both grilled rice balls should be cancelled and there is no need to make them in a hurry.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。焼きおにぎりを明細から外しました。こちらで内容をもう一度ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. I have removed the grilled rice balls from the itemised bill. Please check the details here again.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 焼きおにぎりは消えています。ただ、汁物が三つになっています。頼んで食べたのは二つです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 焼きおにぎりは消えたが、汁物が三つと記載され、実際は二つだったと指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: The grilled rice balls are gone. However, there are three soups listed. We ordered and ate two.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Point out in Japanese that the grilled rice balls have been removed, but three soups are listed although there were actually two.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 入力を確認しました。汁物も二つに直します。訂正後の合計はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I checked the entry. I will correct the soup quantity to two as well. Here is the revised total.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 今度は食べた数と合っています。この合計でまとめて支払います。訂正した明細もいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 訂正後の数量を確認してまとめて支払い、訂正済みの明細を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Now the quantities match what we ate. I will pay this total together. Could I also have the corrected itemised bill?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm the corrected quantities in Japanese, say you will pay together, and request the corrected itemised bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい、訂正後の明細をお渡しします。ご確認ありがとうございました。お気を付けてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes, I will give you the corrected itemised bill. Thank you for checking. Take care on your way.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。魚を選ぶことで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Welcome. How can I help you choose a fish?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。値札の六百円は、一尾の値段ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 値札の六百円が一尾の値段か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, please. Is the six hundred yen on the price tag the price for one whole fish?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the six-hundred-yen price tag is for one whole fish.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 百グラム当たりの値段です。この一尾を量ると、合計は二千四百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: That is the price per hundred grams. Weighing this whole fish gives a total of two thousand four hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一尾で六百円だと思っていました。今日は魚に千五百円まで使う予定なので、まだ包まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 一尾六百円だと誤解しており、予算は千五百円なので包装を待ってほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I thought it was six hundred yen for one fish. I plan to spend up to fifteen hundred yen on fish today, so please do not wrap it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you misunderstood the price as six hundred yen per fish, your budget is fifteen hundred yen, and you want them to wait before wrapping it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では、小さいものを量ってみましょう。こちらは千二百円になります。切り身も比べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then let us weigh a smaller one. This one comes to twelve hundred yen. Would you like to compare fillets too?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 小さい一尾にします。家には小さなフライパンしかないので、焼ける大きさに切ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 千二百円の小さい一尾を選び、小さなフライパンで焼けるよう切ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will take the smaller whole fish. I only have a small frying pan at home, so could you cut it into pieces small enough to cook in it?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Choose the smaller whole fish costing twelve hundred yen in Japanese, and ask for it to be cut to fit a small frying pan.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 下処理して半分に切れます。下処理をしても、お会計は千二百円です。頭はどうしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: We can clean it and cut it in half. Even with the cleaning, the bill will be twelve hundred yen. What would you like us to do with the head?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 頭は要りません。半分に切った身だけを持ち帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 頭は不要で、半分に切った身だけを持ち帰りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I do not need the head. I would like to take home just the flesh cut in half.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you do not need the head and want to take home only the flesh cut in half.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。身を二つに分けて包みます。切った後の重さで値段を計算し直すわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. I will divide the flesh into two pieces and wrap it. We do not recalculate the price based on the weight after cutting.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 選んだ一尾の値段が千二百円で、下処理後も同じなんですね。その内容でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 選んだ一尾は下処理後も千二百円だと確認し、その内容で依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: So the whole fish I chose costs twelve hundred yen, and the price stays the same after cleaning. Please prepare it that way.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the selected whole fish remains twelve hundred yen after cleaning, and request that preparation.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい、千二百円でご用意します。お買上げありがとうございます。包み終わるまでこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes, I will prepare it for twelve hundred yen. Thank you for your purchase. Please wait here until I finish wrapping it.
